description: Check a citation before you repeat it. Submit a DOI, an arXiv ID or a paper title: returns whether it exists, what it is (title, authors, year, container) and whether it has been retracted, cited to Crossref and arXiv. Optionally send what your document claims (title, authors, year, journal) and every field is compared one by one — a disagreement is reported as mismatch, never as verified. A near title match is never reported as verified; a title that is absent from both returns not_found. Not advice. Comes with an Ed25519-signed receipt covering the question, the verdict, the sources and the time, checkable offline against the published key at /.well-known/factstamp-issuer.json — so the check itself can be audited later by someone who was not here.

claimed_authors.description: The authors as your document lists them. Surnames are compared.

claimed_journal.description: The journal or container as your document names it.

claimed_title.description: The title exactly as your document quotes it, to have it compared against the record.

claimed_year.description: The year as your document states it. A difference of one year is tolerated.

query.description: A DOI such as '10.1038/nature12373', an arXiv ID such as '1706.03762', or a paper title.

name: verify_citation
